comments.text: Cory the counterattack clue is when the enemy gets that red aura arounde them, which you thought to be an undogable attack. If you are in focus mode the counterattack window will be longer. When the red aura is present around the enemy just press r2, you will stun the enemy  immediatly. Moreover, if you are in focus mode and the circle on the bottom left side of the screen fills up , you can press r1 to do a quick blitz attack that deals a lot of dmg and has an increased stun dmg application, but by doing so you will decrease the maximal sanity bar, which you can recover by consuimg various items.

Im guessing Silent Hill F must mean Silent Hill "Fox" since they mention foxes so often early on.
